import os
import tempfile
import unittest

from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
from miniconf.loader import load


def _write(d, name, text):
    path = os.path.join(d, name)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(text)
    return path


class IncludeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_inline_and_override_order(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            _write(d, "inc.conf", "a = 2\nb = 2\n")
            main = _write(d, "main.conf", "a = 1\n@include inc.conf\nb = 3\n")
            cfg = load(main)
            self.assertEqual(cfg.get("a"), 2)
            self.assertEqual(cfg.get("b"), 3)

    def test_relative_to_including_file_and_nested(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            _write(d, "sub/leaf.conf", "x = 1\n")
            _write(d, "sub/mid.conf", "@include leaf.conf\n")
            main = _write(d, "main.conf", "@include sub/mid.conf\n")
            cwd = os.getcwd()
            try:
                os.chdir(tempfile.gettempdir())
                self.assertEqual(load(main).get("x"), 1)
            finally:
                os.chdir(cwd)

    def test_missing(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            main = _write(d, "main.conf", "@include nope.conf\n")
            with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
                load(main)

    def test_cycles(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            a = _write(d, "a.conf", "@include b.conf\n")
            _write(d, "b.conf", "@include a.conf\n")
            with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
                load(a)
            s = _write(d, "s.conf", "@include s.conf\n")
            with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
                load(s)

    def test_diamond_is_not_a_cycle(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            _write(d, "shared.conf", "k = 1\n")
            _write(d, "l.conf", "@include shared.conf\n")
            _write(d, "r.conf", "@include shared.conf\n")
            main = _write(d, "main.conf", "@include l.conf\n@include r.conf\n")
            self.assertEqual(load(main).get("k"), 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
